source='''def transform(grid):
    """Tile the grid with its four quarter-turn orientations."""
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]

    bottom = [row[:] + row2[:] for row, row2 in zip(ccw, [row[::-1] for row in g[::-1]])]
    return half + bottom
